aliases: ["Wetland restoration", "Wetland rewetting", "Wetland creation", "Peatland restoration", "Paludiculture", "Floodplain wetland restoration"]
description_short: Restoring, rewetting or creating inland wetlands (incl. peatlands and paludiculture) to recover hydrology, storage, water quality, habitat and carbon in rural landscapes.
description_technical: Wetland management is gated by hydrology (water table, inundation regime, drainage history, water availability). Suitability is reasoned per intervention driver: F1 restoration/rewetting of degraded/drained wetlands (former-extent + hydrology), F2 creation of new wetlands on non-wetland land (terrain + water availability + soil), F3 peatland rewetting + paludiculture (peat-soil presence + drainage state + water table; high carbon value, tropical-peat LMIC relevance). Constructed/treatment wetlands (point-source/ag-drainage) and coastal tidal marsh are registered but PARKED pending scope calls. Floodplain reconnection is split with riparian_buffer by target (wetland body vs streamside strip).
